 MrFixitsTips » Football Tips » Tuesday’s Goals Accumulator Tips: Poland to strike against Sweden in Nations League Acca 
 SlipsTips , 17th November 2026 17th November 2026 , Football Tips , Accumulator Tips , Announcements , 0 
 Check out our expert’s Goals Accumulator tips for Tuesday’s Nations League action, featuring Both Teams to Score and Total Team Goals selections. 
 Our Goals Acca Tips are based on statistical analysis of recent performances. 
 Portugal To Score 2+ (Tuesday, 19:45) 
 Portugal will look to preserve their place at the top of their Nations League group when they visit Wales on Tuesday night. 
 The Selecao had won all four of their games under new boss Jorge Jesus before suffering a shock 4-1 defeat at home to Denmark at the weekend.
 Wales, meanwhile, will finish bottom after losing 3-1 away to Norway last time out.
 Craig Bellamy’s side also conceded multiple goals against Denmark earlier in the campaign, and Portugal will fancy their chances of doing similar damage.
 Denmark vs Norway – Both Teams To Score (Tuesday, 19:45) 
 There is still plenty at stake when Denmark host Scandinavian rivals Norway at Parken on Tuesday night.
 The Danes moved into a strong position with their 4-1 win away to Portugal and will qualify for the quarter-finals if they avoid defeat.
 Norway, on the other hand, need to win by three goals or more to keep their own slim hopes alive.
 Both teams have scored in each of the visitors’ five Nations League matches, so BTTS looks worth siding with again in the Danish capital.
 Hungary To Score 1+ (Tuesday, 19:45) 
 A straight shootout for top spot in Nations League B Group 2 awaits when Hungary host Northern Ireland on Tuesday night.
 Marco Rossi’s hosts have won each of their last three matches and know another victory would secure first place.
 Northern Ireland, meanwhile, travel to Budapest needing just a point after beating Ukraine 1-0 at the weekend.
 Michael O’Neill’s side have been difficult to break down throughout the campaign, but Hungary’s recent winning run makes them worth backing to find the net.
 Poland To Score 1+ (Tuesday, 19:45) 
 Sweden travel to the Tarczynski Arena on Tuesday night knowing they have already secured top spot in Group B4 of the Nations League.
 Graham Potter’s side have won four of their five matches so far, most recently beating Bosnia 3-2 at the weekend.
 With first place already wrapped up, the Swedes can afford to take their foot off the gas and may even experiment with their starting lineup.
 Poland still have plenty to play for, and their goal in the reverse fixture suggests they can get on the scoresheet again here.
